content:
National Aluminium Company Limited (NALCO) has issued Advertisement No. 10260213 for recruitment of Non-Executive Personnel at M&R Complex, Damanjodi.

The official NALCO recruitment portal confirms that online applications opened on 21 May 2026 at 10:00 AM and the original closing date was 17 June 2026 at 11:55 PM. The portal subsequently shows an extension notice for this recruitment.

The official recruitment portal also provides a Call Letter for Online Examination section for Advertisement No. 10260213. However, the exact call-letter release date and CBT examination date are not stated in the accessible official listing, so an unsupported date such as 15 July 2026 should not be used.
statusNote: Official Call Letter link available; exact CBT/admit-card release date not officially verified
